_comment: Film 77 Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 0.01 USD/s, 2 samples each, 2026-11-25; sample 1 used unless noted). Files in /tmp/claude-0/f77/audio/sfx, not in the repo. Everything else from sfx-bibliothek (akzent: bloom, bulb, phone_tap, chime, teletype, shimmer_rings, brass_click, chalk, pages, lever_switch, rumble, gavel, lamp; atmo: lab).

typing.prompt: A person types one short question on a quiet laptop keyboard in a silent night room: soft steady key taps, a brief pause, then one firm soft press of the enter key. Close and intimate, very clean, no music, no voices.

cryo_hum.prompt: A deep low hum of a cryogenic cooling chamber in a quiet laboratory: steady soft electrical drone, faint cold crackle of ice and a slow breath of cold gas venting. Calm, constant and loopable, no music, no voices.
